title: fix(spec,messaging): a push device's locale is described as stored, not as the language pushes render in
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg5yARdbrWsd674TB3515nv2)_

domain:server#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZMkHvuDeVYgTD73qF

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：推送设备 `locale` 的三处描述（设备 schema、设备注册请求、`sys_user_device.locale` 字段及其四种语言的帮助文字）改成如实说法：它只随设备保存，推送不按它渲染，推送用收件人的语言（用户语言，其次部署默认）。
- 为什么改：原描述承诺"推送按设备语言渲染"，实际没有任何代码这样做；手机设成日文、账号设成英文的用户收到的是英文推送。契约说了做不到的事（ADR-0049：要么兑现要么删掉），席位选了最小的方案 1。
- 风险与回滚：只改描述文字和一个测试，运行行为零变化，调用方发什么都照常收；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/push-device.zod.ts`（locale 一行）、`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`（RegisterDeviceRequest.locale 一行）、`packages/services/service-messaging/src/keyed-notification-text.integration.test.ts`（末尾新 describe）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run src/keyed-notification-text.integration.test.ts`，预期 20/20 通过，其中 3 条是新钉的"推送按用户语言而非设备语言"。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #29818

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- `UserDeviceSchema.locale` (`packages/spec/src/system/push-device.zod.ts`): was "Device locale … that pushes to this device are rendered in". Now: stored for the device, as the registration named it; no push renders by it; a push arrives in the recipient's language (`sys_user.locale`, then the deployment default).
- `RegisterDeviceRequestSchema.locale` (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`): the same promise in the request contract a client sends, corrected the same way. **Scope extension approved by the seat (14:22Z):** the dispatch named one spec description; this twin carries the identical wording and defect, so it rides in this PR.
- `sys_user_device.locale` field description (`packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/user-device.object.ts`) says the same; the messaging i18n bundle's `help` for that field is regenerated in `en` (`check-i18n-bundles --write`) and its hand-written `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` translations are rewritten to the new meaning (they otherwise kept translating the old promise). Declared to and approved by the seat.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`, `content/docs/references/system/push-device.mdx` (`gen:docs`). No other spec artifact moved (`check:generated` 14/14 current).
- Changeset: `patch` for `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/service-messaging` (`Metadata-protocol: none`).
- Not done (option 2 of the card, a widening): no `push` row in `TEMPLATE_CHANNELS`, no per-device rendering.

## Tests

A new top-level `describe` in `keyed-notification-text.integration.test.ts` (the shared keyed-text harness: real `ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver`/better-sqlite3, the kernel's in-memory i18n, the real `MessagingService`), adding the real push channel over the real device registry (`sys_user_device`) on a push-service double that records each token's title and body. Each recipient's phone is registered with a locale that is not the recipient's: the `zh-CN` user's phone in `en`, the `en` user's phone in `zh-CN`, the no-locale user's phone in `ja-JP`.

- the device row keeps the locale it was registered with;
- inline fan-out: the `zh-CN` user's phone gets the `zh-CN` sentence, the `en` user's phone the English one, and the no-locale user's phone the deployment default's (`zh-CN`), not `ja-JP`;
- durable path (SQL outbox + dispatcher): the same, rendered at delivery.

Measured on `main` (fa9c0aa2) before any description change: the test was green, so the card's premise holds (pushes render by the recipient, never the device).

## Acceptance notes

- The push relay's `text` member (`packages/spec/src/api/push-relay.zod.ts:78`) also says the line is shown "in the device locale". No producer of it lives in this repository (the relay is cloud's), so nothing here was measured against it; untouched, carrier: cloud.
